{{Quote|The planet Oznek had more than its share of natural perils&hellip; most of them at least as dangerous as the battle droids.|Banks, reflecting on the death of the clone trooper|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' was part of a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] to [[Oznek]] circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]. After crashing their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were forced to camp in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]]. The next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], they undertook a mission to destroy a supposed [[Oznek power plant|droid command center]]. While trekking through the jungle, this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was attacked and eaten alive by a [[Unidentified Oznek carnivore|carnivorous animal]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within" />
